The Trans Am Story

Where Culinary Craft & Visual Art Meet

Trans Am Cafe brings together handcrafted food and local art under one roof. We prepare hearty sandwiches, fresh soups, and daily specials from scratch, while our dining room walls showcase the rotating work of Phoenix artists. It is a casual, welcoming neighborhood spot designed to feed both your appetite and your curiosity.

[01]

Handcrafted Kitchen

Every sandwich is built to order with fresh artisan breads, roasted meats, signature spreads, and crisp local produce.

[02]

Rotating Gallery

Our dining room doubles as a creative showcase, featuring new work from local Phoenix artists every month.

[03]

Community Gathering

A welcoming third place on North Central Avenue to catch up with friends, discover original art, or enjoy a quick espresso.

More Than a Cafe.A Space for Art.

Curatorial Note: Photography and artwork shown are illustrative placeholders demonstrating the cafe's rotating visual identity and exhibition space. Authentic works on display rotate monthly and are provided by featured Phoenix artists.
Community & Exhibitions

Art Happens Here.

Beyond our daily scratch kitchen, Trans Am Cafe serves as an active creative crossroads in Downtown Phoenix. Through monthly exhibition rotations, First Friday art walks, and artist features, our space keeps the neighborhood connected to local culture.

Monthly Rotating Shows

New Perspectives Every Month

Our walls rotate on a regular cycle, giving guests reasons to return and local Phoenix artists a public platform to exhibit and sell their work directly.

Downtown Phoenix Culture
First Friday Walk

Roosevelt Row Art Walk Connection

Every first Friday of the month, Trans Am Cafe participates in the historic Downtown Phoenix Art Walk with extended hours, evening bites, and artist meet-ups.

Downtown Phoenix Culture
Artist Inquiries

Wall Space For Local Talent

We welcome portfolio submissions and exhibition proposals from Phoenix-area visual artists, photographers, and muralists.
